FJORDFALL ORIGINAL EXTERNAL ASSET PACK

Models and textures in this folder were created specifically for Fjordfall v0.3 by OpenAI tooling at the user's request.
They are standalone imported assets (OBJ, MTL, PNG), not runtime primitive geometry and not copied from the reference game.

Permission: The user may use, modify, redistribute, and commercially use these assets as part of the Fjordfall project.
Third-party assets included: none.

Generated asset inventory:
- fjord_house.obj
- fjord_tree.obj
- fjord_longboat.obj
- fjord_wall.obj
- fjord_rock.obj
- fjord_soldier.obj
- fjord_shield.obj
- 9 albedo textures and 6 normal maps
